messages:
Liam (finance): Heads-up — BigByte's renewal invoice looks off. They were charged a prorated platform fee for the migration window, but their support tier switched mid-term and the platform fee proration appears double-counted. They emailed revenue ops: 'we were billed both full platform fee proration and new-tier platform add-on for the same 10-day overlap'. Can someone check?
Priya (acct mgmt): I pulled the renewal invoice: INV-BB-2026-04-01. It shows platform_fee_proration=$18,750 and support_addon_proration=$7,500 for overlap 2026-03-21—2026-03-31. Contract says platform fee is fixed monthly and support tier changes should only affect monthly support line, not duplicate platform proration.
Noah (revops): Hmm — our renewal flow applies proration on both the base SKU and any newly added SKU when the effective date is mid-cycle. Historically we only prorated the delta. I need to check the migration script.
deploy-bot: Deployment change recorded: BigByte support tier upgrade requested by customer on 2026-03-21, approved. Change ticket: CHG-78901.
Priya (acct mgmt): Customer claims they requested the upgrade but didn't intend to pay overlapping platform charges. They want a corrected invoice and a one-time credit for the duplicate proration.
Liam (finance): What's the USD impact of reversing the duplicate platform proration?
Noah (revops): Calculation: platform base monthly = $75,000; daily = 75,000/30 = 2,500. Proration for 10 days = $25,000 but system computed $18,750 plus addon $7,500 = $26,250 due to rounding and addon logic. Duplicate portion = $1,250. Also exchange rounding with EUR billing may add noise for EU invoices.
Priya (acct mgmt): Small amount but customer is sensitive — enterprise ARR > $4M. They asked for admin waiver. Also flagged GCP vendor pass-through surcharge line (kms-egress) that vendor invoiced differently than our expected markup. Two separate issues on same invoice.
Olga (legal): For credits < $5k we can approve administrative credit without an amendment. But we need a short memo and to avoid changing contract terms. If we fix the bug we should add a note to the customer: 'administrative credit applied; billing policy unchanged'.
Liam (finance): Propose: issue $1,250 administrative credit (GL: 4112 Billing Adjustments), correct invoice PDF, and open a ticket for revops to patch proration logic. Also investigate vendor pass-through discrepancy, capture vendor invoice #VND-3342.
Noah (revops): I'll open a bug: PR-3254 — proration should calculate delta only when tier upgrade occurs mid-cycle. Also I'll add unit tests for prorateAddon.
deploy-bot: Vendor invoice linked: VND-3342 (kms-egress) amount=2,120 EUR, expected markup 10% but vendor passed 12% — flagged to vendor-ops.
Priya (acct mgmt): For the vendor pass-through, customer is asking us to absorb the extra 42 EUR. Our policy is to passthrough exact vendor charges. We should ask vendor for correction first. If vendor won't correct, we can offer a one-time goodwill credit of the 42 EUR.
Olga (legal): Agree — ask vendor for a corrected invoice. If vendor refuses, approve up to 100 EUR goodwill credit documented in memo.
Liam (finance): OK path: 1) Apply $1,250 credit to INV-BB-2026-04-01 (status: corrected). 2) Send corrected invoice PDF with note 'administrative credit applied for proration duplication'. 3) Open vendor dispute for VND-3342 and hold the 42 EUR pending outcome; if unresolved after 14 days, issue one-time goodwill credit for 42 EUR and document. 4) No contract change.
Priya (acct mgmt): Customer acceptance: on call they want the corrected invoice and to see the vendor dispute. They agreed to close the escalation if we handle credits quickly.
Liam (finance): Need approvals to post credits. @Olga legal ok? Also cc CFO for >$1k credit?
Olga (legal): Legal signs off on wording for customer note. No contract change needed.
Liam (finance): @Noah can you confirm revops patch ETA? If patch is queued before next billing cycle we'll note remediation.
Noah (revops): PR opened, patch targeted for release 2026-04-05 candidate deploy. I'll include migration tests and a small migration backfill to ensure no historical double-charge.
billing-bot: Created credit memo: BB-CR-2026-04-1, amount=1250.00, status=provisional, created_by=liam.
Liam (finance): Posting credit journal now GL:4112, memo uploaded. Will set credit as provisional until vendor dispute resolves.
Priya (acct mgmt): I'll send customer the corrected invoice and vendor dispute summary.
billing-bot: Vendor dispute opened: VND-3342-dispute-1, status=open, amount=42 EUR, created_by=priya.
Liam (finance): Closing loop: approvals captured in thread. We'll mark invoice corrected and close once vendor either adjusts or goodwill credit issued. Thanks team.
